overview: This table controls how a move's hitting area grows, shifts, and stops while the attack is active.
description: Collision-shape, relative-offset and attack-lifetime parameters used when an attack component is armed; selected through the damage row's Id_CollisionModify and applied by FGameCollisionParameter.

Id.simple: The name that links these hit-area settings to a particular damage move.
Id.technical: FName row key. FGameCollisionParameter::Setup skips the lookup when DamageRow->Id_CollisionModify is None; otherwise it scans CollisionModifyDataTables in load order and uses the first UDataTable::FindRow match. The table Properties use ImportKeyField Id and the native UPROPERTY is Id; the exporter spells the per-row key ID, and it matches the row-map key in all 63 exported rows.

Size.simple: How large the hit area becomes during the move. Bigger values make it larger, and zero leaves it unchanged.
Size.technical: FVector target size. A zero vector is a no-animation sentinel: TickSize returns before any wait/timer work and leaves the shape unchanged. For boxes it lerps cached OriginalSize to Size component-wise and sets box extent; for spheres it averages X/Y/Z of both vectors and sets sphere radius; for capsules it averages X/Y for radius and uses Z as half-height. Units are Unreal world units (centimetres); exported examples include (90,90,200) and (70,70,200).

Size_Time.simple: How long the hit area takes to reach its new size. Shorter times make the change faster, and zero applies it at once.
Size_Time.technical: Seconds, consulted only when a modification row exists and Size is nonzero. CollisionParameter_Alpha yields 1 when Time<=0, otherwise clamps Elapsed/Time to [0,1]; SizeElapsed advances by DeltaTime multiplied by the owner's CustomTimeDilation after alpha is computed. Zero/negative therefore applies the target size on the first animating tick (after any wait); default 0.

Size_WaitTime.simple: How long the game waits before the hit area starts changing size. Longer waits delay the change.
Size_WaitTime.technical: Seconds, cached into FGameCollisionParameter::SizeWaitTime at Setup. While positive, TickSize subtracts scaled DeltaTime and returns without changing shape; default 0 (no delay).

Location.simple: How far the hit area shifts during the move. Bigger values move it farther, and zero leaves it unchanged.
Location.technical: FVector offset in Unreal world units (centimetres) before rotation. A zero vector is a no-offset sentinel: TickLocation returns without touching relative location. Otherwise it rotates Location * Alpha by FQuat(Base) * Rotation130, where Base is the component relative rotation or FRotator::ZeroRotator when bLocation_AbsoluteRotation is true, and then calls SetRelativeLocation(Offset + OriginalLocation).

Location_Time.simple: How long the hit area takes to reach its new position. Shorter times make the shift faster, and zero applies it at once.
Location_Time.technical: Seconds, consulted only when a modification row exists and Location is nonzero. Same CollisionParameter_Alpha rule as Size_Time: non-positive duration gives alpha 1 immediately; positive duration ramps Elapsed/Time. LocationElapsed advances by scaled DeltaTime after alpha computation; default 0.

Location_WaitTime.simple: How long the game waits before the hit area starts shifting. Longer waits delay the movement.
Location_WaitTime.technical: Seconds, cached into FGameCollisionParameter::LocationWaitTime at Setup. While positive, TickLocation subtracts scaled DeltaTime and returns without changing relative location; default 0.

bLocation_AbsoluteRotation.simple: On keeps the hit area's shift steadier as the character turns. Off lets it follow the attack's facing. Most moves use On.
bLocation_AbsoluteRotation.technical: When true, TickLocation uses FRotator::ZeroRotator as the base instead of Component->GetRelativeRotation() before composing cached Rotation130. Affects only the Location offset; default false.

Life_Time.simple: How long the attack's hit area stays active. Bigger numbers last longer, and zero means it has no time limit.
Life_Time.technical: Seconds. Setup stores Life_Time != 0 ? Life_Time : -1, so the header/export default 0 means unlimited (-1, no countdown), as do negative values. Only a positive internal LifeTime counts down by owner-scaled DeltaTime; when that countdown crosses zero, FGameCollisionParameter queues NoCollision through AGameCollisionManager::RequestCollisionEnabled (applied later in ACollisionManager::Tick), zeroes LifeTime, and broadcasts/clears OnHit only if bound. The verified binding is AGameEffect::OnAttackHit, which clears the source's attack-active flag for non-type-1 effects; no character-attack OnHit binding was found in Source.

notes: Single retail asset name CollisionModifyDataTable: AGameDataTableManager::Tick resolves that one primary-asset loader into CollisionModifyDataTables (array +0x710) via AddLoadedDataTables, which skips null tables; Setup nevertheless scans the array in load order and takes the first matching row. (Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:146,243; Source/Abrams/Public/GameDataTableManager.h:154)

The row is cached by pointer in FGameCollisionParameter::CollisionModifyRow when a damage row is armed; Setup replaces it (nullptr for None or a missing ID) and Reset clears it, so ticks do not repeat the table lookup. (Source/Abrams/Private/GameCollisionParameterInterface.cpp:37,52,74,85)

Indirect lookup chain verified: the attack-collision anim notify resolves its Id_Damage through IGameActorInterface::ResolveAttackDamageId (CP_270 remaps first-hit IDs while its projection-sorcery stack count is positive), then Status_FindDamageRow scans DamageDataTable1-5 in order; the resulting damage row's Id_CollisionModify selects this table. Effect Initialize resolves EffectRow->Id_Damage through the same damage finder and also binds OnHit; CN_050/CP_130 action controllers and trap controllers call Setup from their own resolved damage rows. (Source/Abrams/Private/GameAnimNS_AttackCollision.cpp:78,103; Source/Abrams/Private/CP_270_ActionController.cpp:1438; Source/Abrams/Private/GameCharacterStatusController.cpp:3237; Source/Abrams/Private/GameEffect.cpp:1085,1103,1104)

Export relationship: one global 63-row CollisionModifyDataTable plus 20 by-character CollisionModify exports that are exact row subsets (no differing values). Across every global and by-character export shard, 184 damage rows have a non-None Id_CollisionModify; they resolve to 55 distinct IDs, all present in the table, with no duplicate row keys or key/ID mismatches. Eight exported rows (CP_010_ATTACKD_02, CP_050_ATTACKG_01_02, CP_050_ATTACKG_01_03, CP_140_ATTACKD_01_02, CP_180_ATTACKF_01_01, CP_180_ATTACKF_01_02, CP_180_ATTACKF_01_03, CP_200_ATTACKG_1_1) have no exported damage-row reference.

Tick reachability: AddModifiable calls ModSlot4 to snapshot OriginalSize/OriginalLocation (and BootRotation into Rotation130 on character-attack components), TickModifier forwards to FGameCollisionParameter::Tick, and RemoveModifiable restores the snapshot via ModSlot5. The ACollisionManager tick runs modifiers before applying queued collision-enabled changes. Visible parameter-bearing classes are the character/effect capsule and sphere attack components; TickSize retains a box branch, but no box subclass carrying the parameter block was found in Source. (Source/Framework/Private/CollisionManager.cpp:50,59,220,226; Source/Abrams/Private/GameCapsuleComponent_CharacterAttack.cpp:22,30; Source/Abrams/Private/GameCapsuleComponent_EffectAttack.cpp:15,23)

Rotation130 nuance: bLocation_AbsoluteRotation replaces the component-relative-rotation base with identity but does not clear Rotation130; character-attack components cache AGameCharacterManager::BootRotation there, while effect-attack components leave it identity. Exported bLocation_AbsoluteRotation is true in 62 of 63 rows; only CP_140_ATTACKD_01_01 is false despite the native default false.

All visible consumers are static C++ reconstruction. The available Content is partial, so direct Blueprint or other table consumers cannot be excluded; no uncooked asset guesses are used as semantic evidence.
Exported values confirm the serialized schema and representative values but do not by themselves establish meaning.

usages.detail: FGameCollisionParameter::Setup resolves Id_CollisionModify into a cached row (None or a miss leaves it null) and seeds wait/lifetime state.
TickSize ignores zero Size, then animates box extent, sphere radius, or capsule radius/half-height toward Size using Size_WaitTime/Size_Time.
TickLocation ignores zero Location, then animates a relative component offset using Location_WaitTime/Location_Time, OriginalLocation and the Rotation130 frame.
Tick applies all timing with owner CustomTimeDilation; after a positive LifeTime expires it queues NoCollision and conditionally broadcasts/clears OnHit.
Manager load path for the sole CollisionModifyDataTable asset; the array is scanned in load order by Setup.
Attack anim notify resolves the possibly remapped Id_Damage through the five damage shards before Setup reads Id_CollisionModify.
Indirect alias source: ResolveAttackDamageId remaps first-hit damage IDs by projection-sorcery stack count before damage-row and collision-modification lookup.
Effect Initialize arms attack components from EffectRow->Id_Damage via Status_FindDamageRow and binds the only verified OnHit subscriber.
Collision manager tick drives component TickModifier calls and applies queued NoCollision requests after those modifier ticks.
ModSlot4/ModSlot5 snapshot and restore OriginalSize, OriginalLocation and BootRotation used by Size/Location animation.
